basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I have a deep interest in body art, particularly piercings, and enjoy giving and receiving advice about them. In my free time, I experiment with different fasting techniques and build custom PCs. I'm not a fan of long commutes, preferring to work from home. My online activity peaks in the evenings, often after dinner when I'm relaxed and have some downtime. I'm currently in a long-term relationship and we enjoy hiking and exploring new vegan recipes together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diverse background with a degree in graphic design and several years of self-taught experience in technology and nutrition. I frequently read up on new trends and research, especially related to body modifications and health.
